data.name: Integrations_ClaudeSteps
data.value: 1. Install Claude Code on this computer if you have not: claude.com/claude-code 2. Click Connect. Edgepad adds its plugin to Claude Code. 3. Restart open Claude Code sessions, or type /reload-plugins in them. 4. On your phone, open Controls > AI.

data.name: Integrations_CodexSteps
data.value: 1. Install Codex on this computer if you have not: developers.openai.com/codex 2. Click Connect. Edgepad adds its plugin to Codex. 3. In Codex, type /hooks and trust Edgepad. In the Codex app: Settings > Hooks > Review hooks. 4. On your phone, open Controls > AI. It appears once Codex sends its first event.

data.name: Integrations_GitHubSteps
data.value: 1. Click Sign in. A github.com page opens. 2. Enter the code shown here and click Authorize. 3. On your phone, open Controls > GitHub.

data.name: Dev_GeminiSteps
data.value: 1. Install Gemini CLI on this computer if you have not. 2. Click Connect. Edgepad adds its hooks to your Gemini CLI settings. 3. Restart open Gemini CLI sessions.

data.name: Dev_OpenCodeSteps
data.value: 1. Install OpenCode on this computer if you have not. 2. Click Connect. Edgepad adds its plugin to the OpenCode plugins folder. 3. Restart open OpenCode sessions.

data.name: Dev_GiteaSteps
data.value: 1. On your server, open Settings > Applications and create an access token with read access. 2. Click Add, check the server address (Codeberg is the default) and paste the token.

data.name: Dev_BitbucketSteps
data.value: 1. In your Atlassian account, create an API token with read access to Bitbucket. 2. Click Add, enter your Bitbucket email and paste the token.

data.name: Dev_GiteeSteps
data.value: 1. On gitee.com, open Settings > Personal access tokens and create a token with read access. 2. Click Add and paste the token.
